title: Renewal notice standard
content:
Owner: Customer Success Operations.

## Scope
Each batch covers accounts whose renewal date falls in the batch's two calendar months. A notice is required when ARR, in USD, is at least $50,000. Convert non-USD ARR at the treasury rate published for the day the notice is sent.

## Price
Renewal price = current ARR x (1 + uplift). Standard uplift is 7%. Where the contract sets an uplift cap, the uplift is the lower of 7% and the cap. Quote the price in the contract currency.

## Recipient
Send to the account's verified, active contact with the renewal_notice role who has not opted out. Never send to an unverified or inactive address.

## Records
When a notice is delivered, set the account's renewal stage to notice_sent, the notice date to the delivery date, and the renewal price. A notice counts as delivered only if it did not bounce.

## Corrections
If a sent notice quoted the wrong price, send a corrected notice to the same verified contact. The corrected notice's date becomes the notice date. Do not send a second copy of a correct, delivered notice.

title: Parent-agreement coverage for renewals
content: A subsidiary account that orders under its parent's master agreement renews with the parent and gets no separate notice. Set its renewal stage to covered_by_parent and leave notice date and price empty.

title: Legal holds and customer communications
content: While an account has an active legal hold on external commercial communications, send nothing to that account. Set its renewal stage to legal_hold. Once Legal releases the hold, the account is handled normally. The legal holds register is the record of status.

title: Multi-day batch work and handoffs
content: Long batches are often paused with a handoff note in the team channel. A handoff note is a summary, not a record: before continuing, confirm what actually happened in the mailbox, CRM and other systems, since deliveries can bounce and writes can fail after a note is posted. When a batch finishes, post one completion note in #renewals-ops, correcting anything the handoff got wrong.

title: Salesforce renewals (connected app)
content:
- salesforce_list_renewals_v1(renewal_from, renewal_to, page=1): five accounts per page sorted by name; check total_pages. Dates YYYY-MM-DD.
- salesforce_get_account_v1(account_id): contract (master agreement, uplift_cap_pct, notes), parent account, contacts (role, verified, active, opted_out), renewal fields.
- salesforce_update_renewal_v1(account_id, renewal_stage?, notice_sent_on?, renewal_price?): only passed fields change. Stages: not_started, notice_sent, covered_by_parent, legal_hold.

title: Renewals mailbox, Slack, Legal and Treasury (connected apps)
content:
- gmail_search_v1(query, folder?): keyword search of renewals@atlas.example, folders inbox and sent. Bounce notices arrive in the inbox from mailer-daemon.
- gmail_send_message_v1(to, subject, body)
- slack_search_messages_v1(channel, query?) and slack_chat_post_message(channel, text); channel names without '#'.
- legal_list_holds_v1(): every hold with scope, status (active or released) and dates.
- treasury_get_fx_rate_v1(base_currency, quote_currency, rate_date): daily treasury fixing, quote units per base unit.

title: Renewal notice standard (2025)
content: Notices go to every account renewing in the batch window regardless of size, at a flat 7% uplift. Superseded by the October 2026 standard.

title: QBR cadence
content: Strategic accounts get quarterly business reviews; others semiannual.

title: Churn risk scoring
content: Health scores combine usage, support volume and NPS. Red accounts get an exec sponsor.

title: Discount approvals
content: Discounts over 15% on new business need VP Sales approval.

title: Invoice disputes
content: Billing disputes go to AR; CSMs log them in the account timeline.

title: Customer references
content: Ask before using a logo; Legal keeps the approved reference list.

title: Support tiers
content: Premium support includes a named TAM and 1-hour P1 response.

title: Customer onboarding playbook
content: Kickoff within five business days of signature.

title: CRM hygiene
content: Update next steps after every customer call.
